checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One portrait 4:5 flyer with cheerful illustrated flowers
must.why: Final image is 512x640 (4:5) with illustrated flowers down both sides on a cream background.
Bold headline on two lines, spelled correctly.

must.item: Venue exact, all text legible and uncropped
must.why: 'Maple Park, East Gate' is correct and fully visible.

faults.what: The basket is blurry and touches the bottom edge. It is a wicker basket, not the gingham one the assistant described.
The image is small (512x640) and a little soft. The flowers form side strips rather than a full border, which differs from the description given.
The text block sits in the middle with large empty space above it, so the layout feels a bit plain.

summary: A cheerful 4:5 flyer with illustrated flowers and all four text lines exactly right with no extra wording; the only issues are a blurry cropped basket and low resolution.
